name: MD Ashfaqur Rahman
title: AI Engineer & App Developer
tagline: I build AI that understands Bangla and English, and apps people actually use every day.
about: I'm an AI engineer from Dhaka. I like turning AI models into things people can actually use: a voice assistant that understands how we really speak Bangla, a study app that helps students put their phones down, and open models that make Bangla a first-class language for AI.
I work end to end, from training and fine-tuning models to building the desktop, mobile and web apps around them, and I publish my work as open source.

stats.label: Languages my AI speaks: Bangla & English

projects.name: Sohayok (সহায়ক)
projects.subtitle: Your own Siri for Windows, in Bangla and English
projects.description: Say "Tammy" and Sohayok wakes up, listens and acts: opens apps, plays YouTube, changes the volume, types for you and answers questions aloud. It runs quietly in the background from sign-in, entirely on your own PC, and understands Bangla, English and Banglish.

projects.name: Study Mate
projects.subtitle: Study smart. Unlock by learning.
projects.description: An Android app that locks distracting apps until you pass a quick AI quiz on what you studied. You set the exam pattern and pass mark, students under 15 link a parent by QR code, and an AI study buddy answers questions any time.

projects.name: laya-bangla
projects.subtitle: Bangla decision model for routing, moderation and triage
projects.description: Laya fine-tuned for Bangla so it can make typed decisions about Bangla, Banglish and Bangla-English mixed text: route a message to the right team, flag abusive comments, or sort complaints. Every answer is one of your options, with a probability for each.
